cards.name: The Mirari Conjecture
cards.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Return target instant card from your graveyard to your hand.
II — Return target sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
III — Until end of turn, whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy.

cards.name: A Container of Booster Packs
cards.oracleText: {1}, {T}, Exile this artifact: You may reveal a container holding at least three different sealed booster packs. If you do, select one of those packs at random, open it, and put a card from it into your hand. (You're responsible for providing the booster packs and the container. Other cards from the opened pack remain out of the game.)
